title: Lior and the Trail
author: Sable Halloran
blurb: Mara Lockridge, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
